additional_info.subject: RE: A new case manager was assigned to 0474763 CRM:00225325787
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
I hope you are doing well.
Thank you for raising the issue.
After checking thoroughly the timestamp you provided, I find out that: there is no session started after handshake.
1. This means the
Power Line Communication (PLC) link never formed
,
so the EV and charger could not start the CCS charging session.
"SLAC": {"link": "PLC link no SLAC"}
2.
The session ended immediately after handshake failure
"type": "SeccSessionStop"
"curr_ses_active": false
3.
EV did not provide any parameters:
evmaxc: 0
,
evmaxv: 0
,
pilot: 2
(State B),
"EVReady": 0
4.
CableCheck, Auth, ParameterDiscovery all stayed in “Idle
”:
This confirms
the charging sequence never progressed beyond the initial PLC link step
.
Let me know do you have further question about this issue, please?
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com
